name: lisa-wiki
description: Distributable LLM Wiki kernel — ingest, query, lint, and maintain a git-native markdown knowledge base across Claude and Codex.

interface.longDescription: The default backend for the required knowledge role: a git-native LLM Wiki that each repository owns at wiki/. Ingest sources (git, PRs, project-scoped memory, Jira, Confluence, Notion, docs, the web) into durable markdown, query with citations, lint integrity, and absorb existing documentation. Distributed for both Claude Code and Codex.
defaultPrompt: Ingest the latest sources into the wiki
